沈珩顿了步子，直接将人打横抱了起来，“到底怎么了？”边说边往卧室走，步子很急。

楼下，斯蒂芬问朱杰睿：“什么情况？”

“等等不就知道了。”朱杰睿还在烦着自己的危机公关难题。

他也不想大过节的跟过来。

可放着老板单独出来约会，风险太大了。

他只能陪着给老板打掩护。

他见那顾家四人已经逃跑，在这‘浪’费时间已经没有意义，一声令下，自己率先动身。

詹尼弗跟着说道：“我虽然没有见过你，但是我猜你一定是在某个领域很出色的人”。

“你是……”那个外国男人，盯着李少扬手里的匕首，双眼充满了恐惧，不停后退着。

炮天明嘻嘻一笑，不再说什么。雾里花也笑了一下，两人期待着即将开始最混乱的江湖。

家丁显然是很惊讶，不过也没说什么，很有素质把箱子接了过去说：“谢谢！”然后把门给关上。

Shen Heng paused and hugged him up, "What's going on?" As he spoke, he walked towards the bedroom in a hurry.

Downstairs, Stephen asked Zhu Jerry: "What's going on?"

"We'll find out later." Zhu Jierui was still worried about his crisis public relations problem.

He didn't want to come over for a big holiday either.

But letting the boss go out on a date alone is too risky.

He can only accompany and cover for the boss.

Seeing that the four Gu family members had already escaped, there was no point wasting time here, so he gave the order and set off first.

Jennifer then said: "Although I have never met you, I guess you must be an outstanding person in a certain field."

"You are..." The foreign man stared at the dagger in Li Shaoyang's hand, his eyes filled with fear, and he kept backing away.

Pao Tianming chuckled and said nothing more.Wu Lihua also smiled, and the two looked forward to the most chaotic world that was about to begin.

The servant was obviously surprised, but he didn't say anything. He took the box and said, "Thank you!" and closed the door.
